faqSchema.source:
Nobody can promise you a completely pain-free appointment, and I would rather be honest about that than make a claim I cannot keep. I take my time with anaesthetic and check in with you throughout. If something is uncomfortable, tell me and we stop.

No. Plenty of people come in after a long gap. We work out where things stand, sort out anything urgent, and build a plan from there at a pace that suits you.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: Dr Meg grew up on the outskirts of Tokyo, studied Biochemistry in Canada and completed a PhD in Medical Oncology at Oxford before moving to Melbourne as a cancer researcher. She decided she would rather be closer to people, with the chance to fix something in front of her, and graduated with a Doctor of Dental Medicine from the University of Western Australia in 2016.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: Since then she has worked a year in the public system and close to nine years in private practice across regional Western Australia. Regional practice broadens a dentist — in towns where the nearest specialist is a long drive away, work a city practice would refer out has to be handled in-house. She built up implant placement and restoration, molar root canal treatment, difficult surgical extractions, denture work and laser treatment, and has brought that range to Warrnambool.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: She takes particular care with injections and works at a pace anxious patients can manage, explaining each step before it happens and stopping when asked. Everyone is different, and no dentist can promise a completely pain-free appointment.

fields.label: Words

fields.label: Fine print
fields.value: Dr Meg is a general dentist and is not registered as a specialist in any of these areas. Her PhD in Medical Oncology is a research qualification, not a dental one. Suitability for any treatment is determined after a clinical assessment.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Away from the practice, weekends usually involve the two kelpies and a stretch of beach.

fields.label: Heading

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Nobody can promise you a completely pain-free appointment, and I would rather be honest about that than make a claim I cannot keep. I take my time with anaesthetic and check in with you throughout. If something is uncomfortable, tell me and we stop.
